description: This file defines a class 'Formula' responsible for converting spreadsheet formulas, specifically handling cell references and defined names, for ODS (OpenDocument Spreadsheet) files. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library, in the ODS writer module.

classes.name: Formula
classes.description: A class for converting formulas in spreadsheet files, particularly for ODS format, including handling of cell references and defined names.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the formula converter with a list of defined names.

methods.name: convertFormula
methods.description: Converts a given formula string, adjusting cell references and defined names for the ODS format.

methods.name: convertDefinedNames
methods.description: Replaces defined names in the formula with appropriate referencing syntax.

methods.name: convertCellReferences
methods.description: Converts cell references within formulas to ODS-compatible reference notation.
